record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare LINK_CABLE: Minun (3 stars) and Plusle (3 stars). The strategy is shared. Units not listed are not covered. Routing note (NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT): EffectEnum.LINK_CABLE, an Artificial-synergy effect, shares the name; it is a different mechanism (see unresolved) and is not described by this record.
record.summary: At cast the caster spends maxPP, then (if an enemy and a free cell next to the farthest enemy exist) moves itself to that cell with a non-forced moveTo and retargets the farthest enemy. 300 ms later, if the caster is still alive, it looks for a partner: the first board entity of its own team (other id) whose skill is LINK_CABLE. With a partner it deals SPECIAL damage (raw 40/40/40/80 by stars) once to every enemy found on the line from the caster through the partner and on to the board edge, plus all enemies adjacent to the caster and all enemies adjacent to the partner. Without a partner it deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/20/20/40) to the enemies in the 8 cells around the caster. Only the caster deals damage; the partner is a geometry anchor.

targeting.who: other-team units: on the caster-partner line (extended to 12 cells, hence to the board edge), adjacent to the caster, adjacent to the partner; or, without a partner, adjacent to the caster
targeting.note: The cast target is only the trigger. The movement destination is chosen from the farthest enemy by Manhattan distance, not from the cast target. The partner is not required to be Plusle or Minun: any same-team entity with skill LINK_CABLE other than the caster qualifies, and if there are several the first in board scan order (rows y, then columns x) is used. Both Minun and Plusle casting at the same time each find the other as partner and each deal damage (two casters, separate casts).

geometry.shape: partner branch: supercover line from the caster toward the partner, end point 12 cells away along the same angle (so it passes the partner and continues to the edge; the caster's own cell is the first cell), union with the 8 cells around the caster and the 8 cells around the partner; no-partner branch: the 8 cells around the caster

effects.target: each other-team unit in the union of line / adjacent-to-caster / adjacent-to-partner, once (partner branch)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage (apBoost default true, crit = flag captured at cast): x (1 + AP/100) read from the caster at the damage moment; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: requested vs applied vs taken: applied = requested after those multipliers; handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The target set is collected first (a Set, so a unit found by two rules is hit once) and then damaged in insertion order; the returned values are not used. Targets are those present at the 300 ms moment, not at cast time.

effects.target: each other-team unit in the 8 cells around the caster (no-partner branch)
effects.scaling: same multipliers as the partner branch (AP via the default apBoost, cast-time crit flag, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, steam).
effects.resolution: same damage resolution as the partner branch; no deduplication is needed because each adjacent cell holds at most one unit.

declaredRaw.description: moveTo(free cell adjacent to the farthest enemy, chosen by Manhattan distance from the caster), forcedDisplacement false; then setTarget(farthest enemy)

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: skipped when getFarthestTarget returns nothing or getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace returns null. The destination is the free neighbour farthest (Manhattan) from the caster among those of the farthest enemy. Quirk read in the helper: selectedCell is only replaced when the newly farthest enemy has at least one free adjacent cell, so it can still belong to an earlier, nearer enemy while setTarget goes to the (same) farthest enemy computed by getFarthestTarget; if no cell was ever selected the closest free cell to the farthest enemy is used. moveTo with forcedDisplacement false does not consult canBeMoved, swaps cells, puts the caster in the moving state and sets cooldown 100.

timing.note: The damage part is a DelayedCommand pushed on the caster; it runs once its delay has counted below 0 and does nothing if the caster has hp <= 0 by then. Move and retarget happen immediately at cast.

routingNote.note: EffectEnum.LINK_CABLE (Artificial synergy effect) is a different mechanism from Ability.LINK_CABLE; read only to separate them.

starBehavior.note: Both listed units are 3 stars, where the table gives 40 (partner) and 20 (no partner); the 4-star values 80 / 40 (also the ?? fallbacks) are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts. Movement and geometry do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Heavily positional: the destination depends on every enemy's Manhattan distance and on free neighbouring cells; the partner and the line depend on where the same-team LINK_CABLE unit stands at the 300 ms moment, with the line extended past the partner to the edge; adjacency is read after the move.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes selected at the 300 ms moment: partner present (area/line) or absent (adjacent only). No stored state. Each cast spends maxPP and queues its own DelayedCommand; the discharge is cancelled if the caster is dead at that moment. If both units cast, each looks for the other as partner at its own discharge.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 40 per hit target with a partner, 20 without (both 3-star units); the unit may move before. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. No stat helper (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band) is involved because the ability changes no stat; the unrelated Artificial LINK_CABLE synergy effect does change stats but is a separate mechanism.

Other references to the string LINK_CABLE_link are animation names in other abilities and an item. This record covers only the ability
